displayName.zh_CN: 思源 sisyphus MCP & CLI & GIT

description.default: Siyuan sisyphus enables AI Agents to operate your Siyuan with notebook-level permission control, covering most of Siyuan's functionality. Supports desktop、 docker、 mobile.
description.zh_CN: 让 AI Agent 操作你的思源，提供 MCP CLI 两种方式，支持笔记本级权限管控、覆盖SIYUAN绝大部分功能，支持思源的桌面、docker端、移动端。
